page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E6.Flex.32-128 is an x86_64 compute-oriented virtual machine instance powered by AMD EPYC 9J45 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The configuration allocates 32 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs, leveraging simultaneous multithreading with two threads per core. System memory is sized at 128 GB, yielding an allocation of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance does not include integrated local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating system installation and persistent data. No hardware accelerators or GPUs are provisioned, directing all processing tasks directly to the CPU cores. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this profile for compute-intensive workloads where thread throughput exceeds memory capacity requirements. The dedicated core allocation ensures consistent compute availability without host resource oversubscription. Tradeoffs include the operational dependency on external block volumes and a low per-core memory footprint. VM.Standard.E6.Flex.32-128 is structured for batch processing, continuous integration systems, code compilation, and parallel computational jobs.
